completedProject.summary: Aplikasi Cuaca (Weather App) selesai dipoles menjadi production-grade: 1) Cleanup - konsisten package weather_app, hapus folder theme duplikat, INTERNET permission, build SUCCESS; 2) Clean Architecture - buat domain layer (Weather entity, WeatherRepository interface, GetCurrentWeatherUseCase dengan mapping DTO->Domain), AppModule object dengan Hilt (OkHttp, Retrofit, WeatherApi, Repository), ViewModel pakai UseCase + StateFlow sealed WeatherState Idle/Loading/Success/Error; 3) Review - code review 63/100, GRC low risk, build success, paham DI tradeoff @Inject vs @Provides dan dependency inversion.
